messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api us-east-1 - GPU pool 'hosted-gpu-us-east' exhausted; request_queue length > 98th percentile for 6m; autoscaler failed to provision new GPUs (quotaExceeded). p95 latency 3.2s -> 25s, p99 9s -> 120s. 504s increasing. Notifying on-call.
Jana (oncall-sre): I’m on it. Confirming impact window and if any customer-facing jobs are failing.
Marcus (eng-runtime): Logs show autoscaler API calls returning 403 quotaExceeded from cloud provider starting 2123458950. Autoscaler then enters exponential backoff and doesn't retry beyond limit.
Kyle (eng-infra): Cloud quota for GPUs in us-east is at account limit — no free capacity to request. I can open emergency quota request but that takes ~30-60 mins.
Tina (support): Support seeing multiple tickets for timeouts; main affected customers: AcmeAnalytics, ChatCo, and internal test tenants. ChatCo reports ~40% request failures in the last 10m.
Jana (oncall-sre): Immediate mitigations: 1) Enable fallback to smaller model variant (quantized-8) for non-SLA customers. 2) Apply temporary global rate-limit (reduce burst) for free-tier keys. 3) Route critical customers to dedicated pools if available. Who can flip the fallback?
Marcus (eng-runtime): I can enable model fallback via admin toggle: 
```
redwood-admin feature-toggle set hosted-us-east model-fallback-quant8 true --reason "incident"
```
That will route new requests to quant8 variant; KV cache may miss initially.
Kyle (eng-infra): I can route specific customer routes to dedicated if they have reservations. Sending list to support. Also can request provider to honor a soft rollback to preemptible GPU allocations (might be slower to spin up).
SRE-runbook-bot: Runbook check: If autoscaler fails due to quotaExceeded, either (A) escalate to infra to request quota bump, (B) increase minReplica count for pool to pre-provision before autoscaler call, or (C) enable fallback routing. Recommended: enable fallback + throttle non-paid keys.
Jana (oncall-sre): Ok Marcus, Kyle — do fallback + throttle now. Tina, put targeted status update to status.redwood.com: "We are experiencing elevated latencies in hosted-us-east due to GPU provisioning failures; mitigation in progress."
Tina (support): Posting now. Draft: "We are seeing queue buildup and timeouts for hosted API (us-east). Engineers are mitigating by routing non-critical traffic to smaller model variants and increasing capacity where possible. No data loss. Updates every 15m."
Marcus (eng-runtime): Fallback toggle ON. Confirmed: new requests showing quant8 model in logs. Queue growth slowed but existing long-running requests still timing out.
Marcus (eng-runtime): Quick metric dump: 
```
metric: hosted.api.request_queue_length
t=2123459000 -> 12k
metric: hosted.api.p95_latency_us
  t=2123459000 -> 25000ms
metric: hosted.api.p99_latency_us
  t=2123459000 -> 120000ms
errors: 504_gateway_timeout increased by 380% in 10m
```
Jana (oncall-sre): Can we also temporarily bump pool min from 2 -> 6 to keep pre-warmed nodes?
Kyle (eng-infra): I can force scale the pool (admin path) while quota request is pending. Command: 
```
redwood-admin scale-pool --pool hosted-gpu-us-east --min 6 --force
```
This will attempt to claim existing unused nodes first; if provider returns quota error it will fail. Running now.
Kyle (eng-infra): Scale command returned partial success: +2 nodes provisioned, additional requests failed with quotaExceeded. Pool now at min 4. Queue down from 12k -> 7.1k.
Tina (support): Customers getting short retries. Tickets increasing but severity for most is high latency not data loss. Should we offer SLA credits?
Oliver (product): Hold off on credits until we have stabilization and a postmortem. Notify enterprise accounts privately with a short note and ETA.
Jana (oncall-sre): We're seeing backlog draining but p99 still high. Next: Kyle please follow up on quota escalation with cloud provider support — mark P1. Marcus, add a temporary request-level retry with jitter for 502/504 for 30s to reduce user perceived failures.
Marcus (eng-runtime): Implemented server-side retry policy for ephemeral timeouts (30s window) — config pushed. Expecting reduced 504s for idempotent requests.
SRE-runbook-bot: Suggested post-incident actions: update autoscaler to treat quotaExceeded differently (fallback to new pool provisioning strategy), add alert for continuous quotaExceeded > 2m.
Kyle (eng-infra): Quota escalation open with provider ticket #CLOUD-98321 (priority: urgent). Provider ETA ~40-50m. Escalated to account manager.
Jana (oncall-sre): Good. Support, product: send short customer notes listing mitigation (fallback model, retries, partial routing to dedicated).
Tina (support): Sent targeted messages to ChatCo and AcmeAnalytics. ChatCo acknowledged reduced failures after fallback.
Marcus (eng-runtime): Observability: queue now 7.1k -> 1.2k over 18m. p95 25s -> 4.1s. p99 120s -> 9.8s. 504s decreasing.
Jana (oncall-sre): Marking incident as partial-mitigated. We'll keep on-call until fully healthy. Closing actions: 1) follow-up with infra on quota and provider root cause, 2) patch autoscaler to better handle quota errors, 3) document fallback toggle and add automated fallback on quota errors, 4) customer comms + postmortem.
Oliver (product): Schedule postmortem with infra and runtime tomorrow 1100. Add impacted customers to summary.
Kyle (eng-infra): Provider just updated ticket: they freed capacity in the region; additional nodes provisioning now. Pool count target achieved.
Marcus (eng-runtime): Confirmed pool at target, queue draining to <200, p95 ~280ms, p99 ~720ms. No more 504 spike.
Tina (support): Updating status page: "Mitigation successful; recovery in progress. We will send a full incident report within 24 hours."
Jana (oncall-sre): Great work. Filing incident follow-up items in Jira: INF-4521 (autoscaler quota handling), INF-4522 (runbook update), INF-4523 (customer comms). Oncall will handoff in 15m to day shift.
incident-bot: Incident assigned to INF-4521, INF-4522, INF-4523. Handoff scheduled for 2123460000.
Jana (oncall-sre): Handoff: leaving notes above. If anything regresses ping SRE channel.
Marcus (eng-runtime): Leaving logs & timeline in the incident doc.
Tina (support): Closing thread from support side — monitoring tickets for any regression.
SRE-runbook-bot: Reminder: runbook update required to auto-enable model fallback on repeated autoscaler quota errors.
